credit-registration-teacher-error-malfor: Sisu rejected the data we sent as invalid. Support has to fix what we send; sending it again unchanged does nothing.
credit-registration-teacher-error-misreg: These credits were recorded in Sisu and later removed from it. Support has to find out why.
credit-registration-teacher-error-missin: This module has no credit amount, so nothing can be registered for it. Set the credits in the module settings.
This module has no University course code, so nothing can be registered for it. Set the code in the module settings.
credit-registration-teacher-error-no-gra: The grade scale this course uses cannot be expressed in Sisu. Pick a scale Sisu accepts in the module settings.
credit-registration-teacher-error-person: Sisu has no student with this number. The student should check the number they linked; if it is right, support has to look.
credit-registration-teacher-error-retry-: We tried for a week without getting through, and stopped. Sending it again starts a fresh week.
credit-registration-teacher-error-sisu-t: Sisu was unavailable. Sending it again is worth trying.
Sisu did not answer in time, so nobody yet knows whether the credits were recorded. Support checks Sisu before anything is sent again.
credit-registration-teacher-error-sisu-v: Sisu rejected the registration without saying what was wrong with it. Support has to look at what was sent.
credit-registration-teacher-error-study-: This student has no valid right to study this course at the University. The student has to enrol at the Open University.
credit-registration-teacher-error-transp: Sisu could not be reached. Sending it again is worth trying.
credit-registration-teacher-error-unauth: Sisu refused our sign-in. Support has to renew the credentials, and nothing gets through until they do.
credit-registration-teacher-error-unexpe: Sisu answered in a way we could not read. Sending it again is worth trying.
credit-registration-teacher-error-unknow: This failure has no reason we recognise. Support has to look.
credit-registration-teacher-explanation-: These credits could not be registered.
The credits are being registered. This usually takes a few minutes.
The University has no active enrolment for this student on this course, so the credits cannot be registered yet.
The student has not confirmed a student number. The confirmation link goes to the email address the University has for them.
These credits are not being registered.
The credits are in Sisu, the University's study registry.
This status is not one this page knows.
The student has not completed this module yet. Nothing is registered before they do.
The credits have been sent to Sisu, the University's study registry, and it has not confirmed them yet. That usually happens within a few days.
credit-registration-teacher-linking-emai: Confirmation link queued for {{address}}, not sent from our system yet.
Sending the confirmation link to {{address}} failed once; we are trying again.
Sending the confirmation link to {{address}} failed. Ask an admin to resend it.
Confirmation link sent from our system to {{address}} on {{date}}.
credit-registration-teacher-notification: Queued, not sent from our system yet.
Sending failed once; we are trying again.
Sending failed. The student was not told.
credit-registration-unlinked-emails-fail: {{count}} of them never received the confirmation email; support has been notified.
{{count}} of them never received the confirmation email; support has been notified.
credit-registration-unlinked-enrolled-ex: {{count}} enrolled student on this course has not linked a student number yet. Their credits cannot be registered until they do, whether or not they have completed anything.
{{count}} enrolled students on this course have not linked a student number yet. Their credits cannot be registered until they do, whether or not they have completed anything.
credit-registration-with-support-explana: Support is handling these; they are also counted in the statuses beside them.
description-resend-linking-email-student: Read it off the student's card if we do not have it.
heading-credit-registration-config-probl: This module cannot register credits with its current settings.
{{module}} cannot register credits with its current settings.
student-number-check-the-name-is-yours: Check that the name is yours. If it is not, remove the number below.
student-number-confirming-your-address-c: If the University holds this same address for you, confirming it here links your student number without waiting for the email.
student-number-credits-registered-under-: Credits from your courses are registered to this student number.
student-number-linked-automatically-noti: Check that the name above is yours. We linked student number {{number}} to this account because Sisu, the University's study registry, holds your confirmed email address ({{email}}) for that student. Your credits will be registered under it.
student-number-no-registering-courses: None of your current courses registers credits to Sisu. The number is kept for courses that do.
student-number-not-linked: No student number is linked to this account yet.
student-number-step-link-arrives-by-emai: When you finish a course part, we email a confirmation link to your university address, which is not necessarily the one you use here.
student-number-summary-linked: Credits are registered to student number <number>{{studentNumber}}</number>.
student-number-summary-not-linked: No student number is linked yet. We email you a link to confirm it when you finish a course part.
support-mail-line-link-used-by-someone-e: Someone else appears to have used my student number confirmation link.
support-mail-line-need-a-new-confirmatio: I need a new confirmation link for my student number.
support-mail-line-number-linked-to-anoth: My student number is linked to another account and I need it moved to this one.
